children: New Enterprise Associates Discloses 5.1% Stake in Coursera

New Enterprise Associates 13, L.P., alongside affiliated NEA funds, reported beneficial ownership of 5.1% of Coursera, Inc. The group filed on Nov. 13, 2026, after Coursera's share repurchase program reduced the number of shares outstanding. That reduction triggered the filing, not a new share purchase by the reporting group.

The funds say they hold Coursera shares for investment purposes. NEA identifies no current plan to change Coursera's board, management, business, structure, capital or dividend policy, or to pursue a sale or merger. The group says it could acquire or dispose of shares, but names no specific future transaction.

New Enterprise Associates 13, L.P. is a Cayman Islands exempted limited partnership. Its stated business is investing in and assisting growth-oriented businesses, principally in the United States. Its affiliated fund, New Enterprise Associates 17, L.P., is a Delaware limited partnership with the same stated investment focus.
